jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.reason: This is a commercial sales/account management role for energy and manufacturing assurance services — unrelated to the candidate's IR, policy, or intelligence focus. It requires demonstrable sales experience with large global accounts and double-digit revenue growth, which the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Food Assessor (sub-contractor)
jobs.reason: Food safety auditing is entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy/intelligence focus. The role requires a food industry degree, IFS/BRC auditing qualifications, 3+ years food sector experience, and Italian fluency — none of which the candidate has. Multiple hard mismatches.

jobs.title: General Manager, Nordics
jobs.reason: This is a senior P&L-owning General Manager role in commercial inspection and assurance services — entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy/research focus. It requires extensive senior leadership experience the candidate does not have (hard ineligibility on seniority), plus commercial management skills outside their profile.

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Server and Network Engineer
jobs.reason: This is a senior network/cyber infrastructure engineering role requiring deep hands-on experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, Zscaler, Azure networking, and enterprise firewalls — none of which the candidate possesses. Field, skills, and seniority are all mismatched.

jobs.title: EiQ Chief Technology Officer
jobs.reason: This is a C-suite technology executive role leading a 30-person engineering team and a £2M+ budget, requiring prior CTO/VP Engineering experience in SaaS/cloud-native platforms. It falls outside all three of the candidate's target zones and triggers hard ineligibility on seniority (senior leadership title with extensive experience requirements).

jobs.title: Senior Assessor
jobs.reason: Social compliance auditing for supply chains is tangentially related to human rights but is operationally a commercial assessor/auditor role, not policy or intelligence research. The position requires APSCA CSCA / SMETA / SLCP auditor certifications the candidate lacks, is based in Thailand, and Chinese language is advantageous — none of which align with the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: GWO Auditor
jobs.reason: Mismatch on all fronts: this is a wind-energy safety auditing role requiring GWO Auditor Qualification, WINDA registration, IRCA Lead Auditor credentials, and an engineering/OHS degree — none of which the candidate holds. Hard ineligibility on specialist certifications.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Executive/Assistant MKT manager
jobs.reason: This is a B2B marketing role in the testing/inspection/certification industry — entirely outside the candidate's policy/research focus. It also hard-requires 5+ years of B2B marketing experience in the TIC sector, which the candidate does not have, triggering hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Senior Security Consultant
jobs.reason: This is a hands-on penetration testing role requiring deep technical cybersecurity expertise (web/mobile/infrastructure pentesting, OSCP/CREST certifications, exploit development) that the candidate does not possess. It is also a Senior-level position requiring substantial prior pentesting experience. Complete mismatch with the candidate's IR/policy research profile.

jobs.title: Business Support Specialist
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role explicitly requires fluent Spanish (written and spoken) for client engagement, which the candidate does not have. The field (seafood/supply assurance audit support) is also unrelated to the candidate's policy/IR/intelligence targets.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer, School of Physics
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role explicitly requires a PhD in Physics, which the candidate does not hold. Field (physics academia) and skills (experimental/theoretical physics) are entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy background.

jobs.title: Senior Lecturer in Experimental Condensed Matter Physics
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a senior academic physics role requiring a PhD in Physics, postdoctoral experience, and specialist expertise in cryogenics and condensed matter experimental work. Hard ineligibility on the PhD requirement and on the Senior Lecturer seniority level.

jobs.title: Interim Head of Initial Teacher Education
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: role requires QTS (Qualified Teacher Status) or equivalent and extensive experience leading Initial Teacher Education programmes, neither of which the candidate holds. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch — this is a senior teacher-training leadership role unrelated to IR/policy research.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Global Operations
jobs.reason: This is a senior operations leadership role requiring significant prior experience leading cross-functional global projects, line-managing four direct reports, and fluency in the local language (Spanish for Bogota/Mexico City, or relevant language for Johannesburg) — the candidate has neither the seniority nor the required Spanish. Field alignment is also weak: it is internal operations/project management rather than policy or research.

jobs.title: Operations Officer, Europe
jobs.reason: This is a facilities/operations role focused on vendor management, invoice processing, and office administration — not policy, research, or intelligence work. While OSF is a relevant mission-driven organisation, the role requires specific operations experience (facilities management, procurement, vendor contracts) that the candidate lacks, and the substantive work is unrelated to their research profile.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant: SCIS Director
jobs.reason: The role requires at least 10 years of demonstrable experience in a research or similar organisation, which is a hard requirement the candidate cannot meet. While inequality research at SCIS is policy-adjacent, this is an administrative/executive support post rather than a research role.

jobs.title: Officer, Meetings and Events
jobs.reason: This is an events/logistics operations role, not policy or research — outside all three of the candidate's target zones despite OSF being a relevant organisation. The role requires demonstrable end-to-end event delivery experience and vendor management which the candidate lacks, and the Dakar/West Africa coverage realistically needs French fluency (candidate has only B1).

jobs.title: London Office Coordinator (m/f/d)
jobs.reason: ECFR is a core-fit organisation and the EU-UK foreign policy subject area aligns well with the candidate's IR background. However, the role is primarily project coordination, events and office administration rather than research, and asks for 2-4 years of experience in coordination/events plus CRM proficiency — areas where the candidate has only limited exposure through their student assistant roles.

jobs.title: Enterprise Finance Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is a finance/operations coordinator role focused on managing project budgets, purchase orders, and compliance for knowledge exchange projects — outside the candidate's research/policy focus. While it sits within a university research directorate, the work is finance administration rather than substantive research, and the candidate lacks specific KE finance experience.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Law
jobs.reason: This is a permanent Lecturer position requiring expertise in Private Law (IP, Commercial Law, AI) and a proven track record of internationally recognised research — effectively requiring a PhD and substantial academic experience the candidate does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Lecturer / Associate Lecturer (Cybersecurity)
jobs.reason: This is an academic computer science post requiring a PhD (Lecturer) or MSc plus PhD-in-progress in CS/Cybersecurity (Associate Lecturer), with teaching duties in offensive security, cryptography, and related technical fields. Hard ineligibility: candidate holds neither a CS degree nor a doctorate, and lacks the specialist technical cybersecurity background required.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer
jobs.reason: This is a general executive/administrative support role in a clinical medicine school, not a research or policy role. The field is largely unrelated to the candidate's IR/security/policy focus, and it requires 3 years of executive administration experience which the candidate does not have in a full-time capacity.

jobs.title: Group Head of Financial Planning & Analysis
jobs.reason: Although Control Risks is a core target organisation, this is a senior finance leadership role requiring extensive FP&A and accounting expertise the candidate does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority (Head-level role) and skills mismatch (financial planning/accounting qualifications).

jobs.title: Experiential & Content Producer
jobs.reason: This is a creative agency production role focused on experiential events, content shoots, and integrated brand campaigns for commercial clients — entirely outside the candidate's policy/research/intelligence target zones. The role requires hands-on production experience with budgets, vendors, and live activations that the candidate does not have.
